from: Someone must check the figures before the call.
frame: The figures ___ checked before the call.

ok.de: Richtig: must + be + Partizip. Die Zahlen werden geprüft, sie prüfen nicht selbst.
ok.en: Right: must + be + participle. The figures get checked; they check nothing themselves.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort must muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word must must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach dem Modalverb steht be, nicht been: must be checked.
wrong.en: After the modal verb use be, not been: must be checked.

wrong.de: Ohne be fehlt das Passiv: must be checked.
wrong.en: Without be the passive is missing: must be checked.

from: I think someone ought to tell the client about the delay.

ok.de: Richtig: should + be + Partizip. Der Kunde bekommt die Information, er gibt sie nicht.
ok.en: Right: should + be + participle. The client receives the news; he does not give it.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort should muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word should must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach should steht be, nicht been oder being.
wrong.en: After should use be, not been or being.

wrong.de: Aktiv: Der Kunde würde selbst informieren. Es braucht be + Partizip.
wrong.en: Active: the client would be informing someone. It needs be + participle.

prompt: The proposal can approved by the board next week.
fixed: The proposal can be approved by the board next week.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Nach can fehlt be. Richtig: can be approved.
ok.en: The error: be is missing after can. Correct: can be approved.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach can fehlt be.
wrong.en: There is an error: be is missing after can.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „can approved“: Modal + be + Partizip.
wrong.en: The error is in “can approved”: modal + be + participle.

prompt: All attendees must been notified before the workshop starts.
fixed: All attendees must be notified before the workshop starts.

ok.de: Der Fehler: „must been“. Nach einem Modalverb steht die Grundform be: must be notified („before the workshop“).
ok.en: The error: “must been”. After a modal comes the base form be: must be notified (“before the workshop”).

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach must steht be, nicht been.
wrong.en: There is an error: after must use be, not been.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „been“: Nach must steht be.
wrong.en: The error is in “been”: be follows must.

prompt: The new policy has to be explained to every team leader.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: has to + be + Partizip ist das Passiv mit Modal.
ok.en: No error: has to + be + participle is the passive with a modal.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: has to be explained ist richtig gebaut.
wrong.en: No error: has to be explained is built correctly.

prompt: The old files should be delete from the shared drive.
fixed: The old files should be deleted from the shared drive.

ok.de: Der Fehler: delete nach be. Im Passiv steht das Partizip: should be deleted, nicht die Grundform.
ok.en: The error: delete after be. The passive takes the participle: should be deleted, not the base form.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach be fehlt die Partizip-Endung.
wrong.en: There is an error: the participle ending is missing after be.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „delete“: be + Partizip, also deleted.
wrong.en: The error is in “delete”: be + participle, so deleted.

a: The files should be sent today.
b: The files must be sent today.

q.de: Welcher Satz drückt eine strikte Pflicht aus, nicht nur eine Empfehlung?
q.en: Which sentence expresses a strict obligation, not just a recommendation?

ok.de: Satz b: must ist eine Pflicht. Satz a mit should ist nur eine Empfehlung, die Dateien müssten nicht gesendet werden.
ok.en: Sentence b: must is an obligation. Sentence a with should is only a recommendation, the files would not have to be sent.

wrong.de: In a steht should: eine Empfehlung, keine feste Pflicht.
wrong.en: Sentence a has should: a recommendation, not a firm obligation.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: should rät, must verlangt.
wrong.en: Not the same: should advises, must demands.

from: The team had already sent the invoices before the client called.
frame: The invoices ___ sent before the client called.

ok.de: Richtig: had already been. Das Senden lag vor dem Anruf des Kunden.
ok.en: Right: had already been. The sending came before the client's call.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort already muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word already must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Mit before the client called braucht es had been: früher als der Anruf.
wrong.en: With before the client called use had been: earlier than the call.

wrong.de: Das Passiv braucht been: had already been sent.
wrong.en: The passive needs been: had already been sent.

from: Someone has just announced the new strategy.

ok.de: Richtig: has just been. just betont: Es ist eben erst passiert, das Ergebnis gilt jetzt.
ok.en: Right: has just been. just stresses: it only now happened, and the result holds now.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort just muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word just must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Das Passiv braucht been: has just been announced.
wrong.en: The passive needs been: has just been announced.

wrong.de: Ohne Zeitangabe gilt das Perfekt: has just been, nicht had just been.
wrong.en: With no past time given the perfect fits: has just been, not had just been.

from: The IT team fixed the bug on Tuesday.
frame: The bug ___ by the IT team on Tuesday.

ok.de: Richtig: was fixed. Mit „on Tuesday“ steht das Simple Past im Passiv.
ok.en: Right: was fixed. “On Tuesday” takes the passive simple past.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort fixed muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word fixed must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Mit on Tuesday steht kein has been: Ein fester Zeitpunkt braucht was.
wrong.en: With on Tuesday no has been: a finished time needs was.

wrong.de: Das Passiv braucht was + Partizip: was fixed.
wrong.en: The passive needs was + participle: was fixed.

prompt: The new logo has been presented to the board on Monday.
fixed: The new logo was presented to the board on Monday.

ok.de: Der Fehler: „on Monday“ ist ein fester Zeitpunkt. Richtig: was presented.
ok.en: The error: “on Monday” is a finished time. Correct: was presented.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Mit on Monday passt has been nicht.
wrong.en: There is an error: has been does not fit with on Monday.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „has been presented“: fester Zeitpunkt, also was.
wrong.en: The error is in “has been presented”: a finished time needs was.

prompt: By the time the client called, the invoice has been sent.
fixed: By the time the client called, the invoice had been sent.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Mit „by the time … called“ steht had been, nicht has been.
ok.en: The error: with “by the time … called” use had been, not has been.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Die Zeitform passt nicht zu by the time.
wrong.en: There is an error: the tense does not fit by the time.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „has been“: Es geschah vor dem Anruf, also had been.
wrong.en: The error is in “has been”: it happened before the call, so had been.

prompt: The invoice had been paid by the time the auditors arrived.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: had been + Partizip passt zu by the time, es war früher.
ok.en: No error: had been + participle fits by the time, it was earlier.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: Die Zahlung lag vor der Ankunft, daher had been paid.
wrong.en: No error: the payment came before the arrival, hence had been paid.

prompt: The meeting room had cleaned before we arrived.
fixed: The meeting room had been cleaned before we arrived.

ok.de: Der Fehler: „had cleaned“ ist aktiv. Das Passiv heißt had been cleaned.
ok.en: The error: “had cleaned” is active. The passive is had been cleaned.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Im Passiv fehlt been.
wrong.en: There is an error: been is missing in the passive.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „had cleaned“: Der Raum putzt nicht selbst.
wrong.en: The error is in “had cleaned”: the room does not clean itself.

a: The invoice was paid on Friday.

q.de: Welcher Satz nennt keinen Zeitpunkt und betont, dass die Sache jetzt erledigt ist?
q.en: Which sentence names no time and stresses that the matter is settled now?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz b. has been paid betont das Ergebnis bis jetzt, ohne Zeitpunkt.
ok.en: Right: sentence b. has been paid stresses the result up to now, with no time.

wrong.de: a nennt Friday als abgeschlossenen Zeitpunkt: Simple Past.
wrong.en: Sentence a names Friday as a finished time: simple past.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: was paid datiert die Zahlung, has been paid zählt das Ergebnis.
wrong.en: Not the same: was paid dates the payment, has been paid counts the result.

from: People say that the new director is very demanding.

ok.de: Richtig: is said to be. Das Gerücht steht im Passiv, danach folgt to + Infinitiv.
ok.en: Right: is said to be. The rumor is in the passive, followed by to + infinitive.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort said muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word said must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach said folgt to + Infinitiv: said to be very demanding.
wrong.en: After said comes to + infinitive: said to be very demanding.

wrong.de: Das Passiv braucht is vor said: is said to be.
wrong.en: The passive needs is before said: is said to be.

from: Experts believe that the company lost a lot of customers last year.
frame: The company ___ a lot of customers last year.

ok.de: Richtig: is believed to have lost. Das Verlieren liegt vor der Annahme: to have + Partizip.
ok.en: Right: is believed to have lost. The losing came earlier than the belief: to have + participle.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort believed muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word believed must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Für Früheres steht to have + Partizip: to have lost.
wrong.en: For earlier events use to have + participle: to have lost.

wrong.de: Nach to have steht das Partizip lost, nicht lose.
wrong.en: After to have the participle lost is needed, not lose.

prompt: The merger is expected completing in June.
fixed: The merger is expected to complete in June.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Nach expected fehlt to. Richtig: expected to complete.
ok.en: The error: to is missing after expected. Correct: expected to complete.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach is expected folgt to + Infinitiv.
wrong.en: There is an error: after is expected comes to + infinitive.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „expected completing“: nach expected steht to.
wrong.en: The error is in “expected completing”: to follows expected.

prompt: The founder is said to has left the firm in 2019.
fixed: The founder is said to have left the firm in 2019.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Nach to steht der Infinitiv: to have left.
ok.en: The error: after to the infinitive is needed: to have left.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach to steht have, nicht has.
wrong.en: There is an error: after to use have, not has.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „has“: Nach to steht have + Partizip.
wrong.en: The error is in “has”: after to use have + participle.

prompt: The bank is said to planning layoffs.
fixed: The bank is said to be planning layoffs.

ok.de: Der Fehler: „to planning“. Richtig: to be planning oder to plan.
ok.en: The error: “to planning”. Correct: to be planning or to plan.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach to fehlt be oder die Grundform.
wrong.en: There is an error: be or the base form is missing after to.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „to planning“: Nach to steht be planning oder plan.
wrong.en: The error is in “to planning”: after to use be planning or plan.

prompt: The two firms are said to be close to an agreement.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: are said to be … gibt das Gerücht sachlich wieder.
ok.en: No error: are said to be … reports the rumor neutrally.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: are said to be ist hier richtig gebaut.
wrong.en: No error: are said to be is built correctly here.

a: The warehouse is said to be closing.

q.de: Welcher Satz gibt nur ein Gerücht wieder und lässt offen, ob es stimmt?
q.en: Which sentence only passes on a rumor and leaves it open whether it is true?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz a. is said to = man sagt es, aber ob es stimmt, bleibt offen.
ok.en: Right: sentence a. is said to = people say so; whether it is true stays open.

wrong.de: b stellt es als Tatsache dar, ohne Quelle.
wrong.en: Sentence b presents it as a fact, with no source.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: b behauptet es sicher, a gibt nur ein Gerücht wieder.
wrong.en: Not the same: b states it as certain, a only passes on a rumor.

from: She was upset because nobody had told her about the change.
frame: She was upset about ___ about the change.

ok.de: Richtig: not being told. Nach der Präposition about steht -ing, im Passiv being + Partizip.
ok.en: Right: not being told. After the preposition about comes -ing, in the passive being + participle.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort being muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word being must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach about steht being + Partizip, nicht to be: not being told.
wrong.en: After about use being + participle, not to be: not being told.

wrong.de: Aktiv: Sie wurde informiert, sie informierte nicht. Gesucht: being + Partizip.
wrong.en: Active: she was the one informed, not the informer. Needed: being + participle.

from: Nobody asked for his opinion, and he left the meeting early.
frame: He left the meeting early without ___ for his opinion.

ok.de: Richtig: being asked. Nach without steht -ing, im Passiv being + Partizip.
ok.en: Right: being asked. After without comes -ing, in the passive being + participle.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort being muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word being must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach without steht being + Partizip, nicht to be: being asked.
wrong.en: After without use being + participle, not to be: being asked.

wrong.de: Aktiv: Er wurde gefragt, er fragte nicht. Gesucht: being + Partizip.
wrong.en: Active: he was the one asked, not the asker. Needed: being + participle.

prompt: I really appreciate to be kept informed about the project.
fixed: I really appreciate being kept informed about the project.

ok.de: Der Fehler: „appreciate to be“. Nach appreciate steht -ing: appreciate being kept informed. Deutsch „zu“ verleitet zu to.
ok.en: The error: “appreciate to be”. After appreciate comes -ing: appreciate being kept informed. German “zu” tempts you into to.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach appreciate folgt being, nicht to be.
wrong.en: There is an error: appreciate is followed by being, not to be.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „to be“: appreciate + being + Partizip.
wrong.en: The error is in “to be”: appreciate + being + participle.

prompt: She hates being interrupt when she presents.
fixed: She hates being interrupted when she presents.

ok.de: Der Fehler: interrupt nach being. Im Passiv steht das Partizip: being interrupted („she hates being …“).
ok.en: The error: interrupt after being. The passive takes the participle: being interrupted (“she hates being …”).

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach being fehlt die Partizip-Endung.
wrong.en: There is an error: the participle ending is missing after being.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „interrupt“: being + Partizip, also interrupted.
wrong.en: The error is in “interrupt”: being + participle, so interrupted.

prompt: He was angry about not been invited to the launch.
fixed: He was angry about not being invited to the launch.

ok.de: Der Fehler: „not been invited“. Nach about steht -ing, verneint not being invited. been ist eine andere Form.
ok.en: The error: “not been invited”. After about comes -ing, negated not being invited. Been is a different form.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach about not fehlt being statt been.
wrong.en: There is an error: being is needed instead of been after about not.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „been“: Nach about steht being + Partizip.
wrong.en: The error is in “been”: after about use being + participle.

prompt: The intern was upset about being left out of the meeting.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Nach about steht -ing, im Passiv being + 3. Form: about being left out.
ok.en: No error: after about comes -ing, and in the passive being + participle: about being left out.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: Nach about steht being left out ganz richtig.
wrong.en: No error: being left out is exactly right after about.

a: I don't like asking customers for feedback.
b: I don't like being asked for feedback.

q.de: Welcher Satz sagt: Ich werde nicht gern um Feedback gebeten?
q.en: Which sentence says: I do not like it when I am asked for feedback?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz b. Mit being asked werde ich gefragt, und nicht ich frage.
ok.en: Right: sentence b. being asked = I am the one asked (passive).

wrong.de: In a fragst du selbst: asking ist aktiv.
wrong.en: In a you do the asking: asking is active.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: asking = ich frage, being asked = ich werde gefragt.
wrong.en: Not the same: asking = I ask, being asked = I get asked.
